name: A Reykjavík garden

place_source.title: Wikidata: Reykjavík (Q1764), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A suburban garden on the edge of Reykjavík: a lawn, a border of birch and willow, a pond for ducks and geese, visited by ravens, starlings, redpolls and the occasional arctic fox after dark.

facts.text: Reykjavík has a subpolar oceanic climate (Köppen Cfc), with cool summers and mild winters for its latitude.
